interview.name: Leo
interview.answer: It’s on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Leo is responsive and willing to take on practical support tasks for the repair drive.
Ira is organizing outreach and donation collection, suggesting a coordination role.
Sam is offering concrete in-person help and has an easygoing, supportive rapport with Leo.
Leo is the reliable organizer who coordinates the repair drive and relays requests from others.
Sam and Gus are both willing to lend tools and hands-on help, suggesting a cooperative local support network around Leo.
Rey is contributing quietly but specifically, and prefers to keep their involvement low-profile while still helping.
Leo is the main coordinator and keeps responses practical, flexible, and responsive to others' constraints.
Several people are contributing to the repair drive in small ways, suggesting a cooperative but low-pressure group effort.
People are asking Leo to relay details and preferences, so he is functioning as a trusted communication hub.
Leo is reliable and responsive, especially around coordinating repair drive details and follow-up updates.
The others tend to rely on Leo for logistical support and appreciate his flexibility and quick communication.
The repair drive group is coordinated and task-oriented, with timing, availability, and remaining work being the main concerns.
Leo is the main organizer keeping the repair drive moving and sharing updates with multiple people.
Mara appears to coordinate logistics and delegate follow-up work to Leo.
Opal and Vik are supportive helpers who relay details and help keep others informed.
